title: PRIME: Frequency-Aware Unified Pruning and Merging for MoE Compression
abstract: arXiv:2610.13982v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models have emerged as an effective paradigm for scaling large language models, yet their massive parameter footprint poses severe memory challenges for deployment. Existing compression methods typically treat expert pruning and merging as disjoint operations and rely on greedy heuristics, often leading to irreversible information loss or representational pollution. In this paper, we propose PRIME, a unified optimization framework for MoE compression via adaptive PRunIng and MErging. PRIME casts the discrete prune-merge assignment step as a global Integer Linear Programming over a frequency-weighted surrogate objective, jointly selecting pruning and merging decisions while accounting for expert usage. translated_title: PRIME：面向MoE压缩的频率感知统一剪枝与合并
translated_abstract: 混合专家（MoE）模型已成为扩展大语言模型的有效范式，但其庞大的参数规模给部署带来了严峻的内存挑战。现有的压缩方法通常将专家剪枝和专家合并视为相互独立的操作，并依赖贪心启发式策略，这往往导致不可逆的信息丢失或表征污染。在本文中，我们提出了PRIME，一个通过自适应剪枝与合并来实现MoE压缩的统一优化框架。PRIME将离散的剪枝-合并分配步骤建模为在频率加权代理目标上的全局整数线性规划（Integer Linear Programming），在考虑专家使用情况的同时，联合选择剪枝和合并决策。我们通过在固定代表分配下的误差界分析论证了频率感知目标的合理性，并表明该公式倾向于将高频专家选为聚类中心，从而促进路由稳定性……
tldr: PRIME提出了一个统一优化框架，将MoE压缩中的专家剪枝与合并决策联合建模为频率加权目标上的全局整数线性规划问题，从而在保留高频专家作为聚类中心的同时实现高效压缩。
en_tdlr: PRIME unifies expert pruning and merging for MoE compression by formulating the discrete prune-merge assignment as a global Integer Linear Programming problem over a frequency-weighted objective, jointly optimizing both decisions while favoring high-frequency experts as centroids.
